tailnet: Every box carries its tailnet (Tailscale) name and address. The tailnet name is the cross-box identifier (Andrew-direct 2026-10-07): it rides every bus message beside the sender's serial, and every NEW per-box resource name (queue, IAM user, policy) takes it. Three boxes' register names equal their tailnet names; the laptop's is cloud-local, carried as an alias.
